chatParticipants.name: diagram
chatParticipants.description: Understands TypeScript, TSX, and activity diagrams using your current code and diagram context.

languageModelTools.name: create_activity_diagram
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generates an activity diagram from TypeScript/JavaScript source code and displays it in the activity diagram panel. Use this when the user asks to create, generate, show, or visualize an activity diagram from code. Pass the specific function code as 'sourceText' if the user asked about a specific function; otherwise omit it to use the active editor.

sourceText.description: The TypeScript/JavaScript source code to turn into an activity diagram. Optional — when omitted, the tool uses the active editor's content.

title.description: Optional human-readable title for the diagram.

languageModelTools.name: create_code_from_activity_diagram
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generates TypeScript code from the currently open activity diagram. Use this ONLY when the user explicitly asks to generate, create, produce, or build code FROM an existing activity diagram (e.g. 'generate code from this diagram', 'turn this diagram into code', 'create a skeleton from the diagram'). Requires an activity diagram to be open in the panel.

title.description: Optional title for the generated code file.

reactDiagrams.chat.diagramJson.description: Include activity diagram JSON when available.

reactDiagrams.chat.diagramMermaid.description: Include activity diagram Mermaid (generated from current nodes and edges) when available.

reactDiagrams.chat.diagramImage.description: Include rendered diagram image when available.

reactDiagrams.chat.allowToolCall.description: Allow the chat participant to call diagram/code generation tools.

reactDiagrams.chat.maxToolIterations.description: Maximum number of tool-call iterations per chat request.

reactDiagrams.chat.diagramImageTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for capturing the rendered diagram image.

reactDiagrams.chat.debug.description: Show debug information in chat responses.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build:webview && npm run package
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
